# Load the dataset with correct delimiter
df <- read.csv('/Users/yawenliang/Desktop/CBS courses/Semester 2/Predictive Analytics/Final /PRIS111.csv', sep = ";")

# Convert 'TID' (e.g., "2005M04") into proper date format
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(substr(TID, 1, 4)),
    Month = as.numeric(substr(TID, 6, 7)),
    Date = as.Date(paste(Year, Month, "01", sep = "-"))
  ) %>%
  select(Date, Inflation = INDHOLD) %>%
  arrange(Date)

#Convert to time series object (ts)
cpi_ts <- ts(df$Inflation, start = c(df$Date[1] %>% year(), df$Date[1] %>% month()), frequency = 12)

#Quick check
plot(cpi_ts, main = "Denmark YoY CPI Change (%)", ylab = "Inflation (%)", xlab = "Year")

# Load libraries
library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)

# Decompose the time series
decomp <- stl(cpi_ts, s.window = "periodic")

# Plot the decomposition
plot(decomp, main = "STL Decomposition of Denmark YoY CPI Inflation")

# Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test (null = non-stationary)
library(tseries)
adf.test(cpi_ts)

# Structural Break Detection using Bai-Perron method
library(strucchange)

# Run breakpoint analysis on CPI level
bp_model <- breakpoints(cpi_ts ~ 1)

# View summary of breakpoints
summary(bp_model)

# Plot breakpoints over time
plot(bp_model, main = "Breakpoints in Denmark CPI Time Series",
     xlab = "Number of Breakpoints", ylab = "BIC and Residual Sum of Squares")


# Overlay break-adjusted fit
plot(cpi_ts, main = "Denmark CPI with Breakpoints", ylab = "YoY Inflation (%)")
lines(fitted(bp_model, breaks = 1), col = "red", lwd = 2)

#CUSUM test
sctest(cpi_ts ~ 1, type = "OLS-CUSUM")


# Fit ARIMA model
fit_arima <- auto.arima(cpi_ts)

# Fit ARIMA model summary and forecast
summary(fit_arima)
forecast_arima <- forecast(fit_arima, h = 12)
plot(forecast_arima, main = "ARIMA Forecast: Denmark CPI (YoY %)")

# Fit ETS model
fit_ets <- ets(cpi_ts)

# Fit ETS model summary and forecast
summary(fit_ets)
forecast_ets <- forecast(fit_ets, h = 12)
plot(forecast_ets, main = "ETS Forecast: Denmark CPI (YoY %)")

#residual Diagnostics (for ARIMA and ETS)

# ACF plot of residuals
checkresiduals(fit_arima)

checkresiduals(fit_ets)

#Ljung-Box Test
Box.test(residuals(fit_arima), lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(residuals(fit_ets), lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")

#Plot the Forecasts

library(gridExtra)

p1 <- autoplot(forecast(fit_arima, h = 12)) +
  ggtitle("ARIMA Forecast: Denmark CPI") + ylab("YoY % Change")

p2 <- autoplot(forecast(fit_ets, h = 12)) +
  ggtitle("ETS Forecast: Denmark CPI") + ylab("YoY % Change")

grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)

#Plot Seasonality or Decomposition Clearly
stl_decomp <- stl(cpi_ts, s.window = "periodic")
autoplot(stl_decomp) + ggtitle("STL Decomposition of Denmark CPI (YoY %)")

#Train/Test Forecast Evaluation
#Split data
train <- window(cpi_ts, end = c(2023, 12))
test <- window(cpi_ts, start = c(2024, 1))

#Fit on training
fit_arima_train <- auto.arima(train)
fit_ets_train <- ets(train)

#Forecast 12 months
fc_arima <- forecast(fit_arima_train, h = 12)
fc_ets <- forecast(fit_ets_train, h = 12)

#Accuracy on test set
accuracy(fc_arima, test)
accuracy(fc_ets, test)

#Compare Prediction Intervals
#Compare 80% and 95% forecast interval width
fc_arima <- forecast(fit_arima, h = 12)
fc_ets   <- forecast(fit_ets, h = 12)

arima_interval_width <- fc_arima$upper[,2] - fc_arima$lower[,2]
ets_interval_width   <- fc_ets$upper[,2] - fc_ets$lower[,2]

mean(arima_interval_width)  # Average width of ARIMA 95% interval
mean(ets_interval_width)    # Average width of ETS 95% interval

#Seasonal ARIMA
# Try forcing seasonal differencing
fit_sarima <- auto.arima(cpi_ts, seasonal = TRUE, D = 1)

#Check seasonal ARIMA summary
summary(fit_sarima)
